pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo attano bhaṇḍakaṃ apassantiyo caṇḍakāḷiṃ bhikkhuniṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:1.5: “ahameva nūna corī, ahameva nūna alajjinī” yā ayyāyo attano bhaṇḍakaṃ apassantiyo tā maṃ evamāhaṃsu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:1.7: sacāhaṃ ayye tumhākaṃ bhaṇḍakaṃ gaṇhāmi assamaṇī homi brahmacariyā cavāmi nirayaṃ upapajjāmi,
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:1.8: yā pana maṃ abhūtena evamāha sāpi assamaṇī hotu brahmacariyā cavatu nirayaṃ upapajjatūti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:1.9: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:1.10: “kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā caṇḍakāḷī attānampi parampi nirayenapi brahmacariyenapi abhisapissatī”ti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:1.11: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave caṇḍakāḷī bhikkhunī attānampi parampi nirayenapi brahmacariyenapi abhisapatīti,
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:1.14: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave, caṇḍakāḷī bhikkhunī attānampi parampi nirayenapi brahmacariyenapi abhisapissati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:1.16: evañca pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:1.17.1: “yā pana bhikkhunī attānaṃ vā paraṃ vā nirayena vā brahmacariyena vā abhisapeyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:2.1.9: nirayena vā brahmacariyena vā abhisapati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:2.2.1: upasampannāya upasampannasaññā nirayena vā brahmacariyena vā abhisapati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:2.2.2: upasampannāya vematikā nirayena vā brahmacariyena vā abhisapati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:2.2.3: upasampannāya anupasampannasaññā nirayena vā brahmacariyena vā abhisapati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc19:2.2.4: tiracchānayoniyā vā pettivisayena vā manussadobhaggena vā abhisapati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
